correctness.rationale: The full face enumeration (5088), all 2519 matching pairs and all 22128 directed incidences are reconstructed and checked for acyclicity; the resulting critical count (1,1,48) in degrees (0,1,3) implies a CW model with no two-cells, hence each 3-cell attaching map to S^1 vanishes by pi_2(S^1)=0. This proves the integral wedge equivalence. Independent mod-two chain elimination is consistent but is not substituted for integral proof.

value.rationale: The graph of the exceptional regular self-dual 24-cell is a canonical graph, and its open-neighborhood complex is central to Lovasz topological graph-coloring theory. This exact homotopy classification exposes a natural mixed-dimensional S^1 and 48 S^3 structure behind seven-dimensional simplices, distinguishing it from known independence or hypercube neighborhood calculations. The precise invariant is mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary slice.
